headlines.description: — Tyler Loop's final dress rehearsal is over. Baltimore's new kicker looks ready.
headlines.shortLinkText: Loop kicks 61-yard field goal as Ravens finish preseason undefeated with 30-3 win over Commanders

headlines.description: — Third-stringer Riley Leonard completed 15 of 20 passes for 189 yards and a touchdown as the Indianapolis Colts beat the Cincinnati Bengals 41-14 on Saturday in the preseason finale for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Third-string QB Riley Leonard shines as Colts beat Bengals 41-14 in preseason finale

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: — Browns coach Kevin Stefanski went with Tyler Huntley instead of Shedeur Sanders when his team had a chance for a winning preseason drive on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Shedeur Sanders struggles, Tyler Huntley leads Browns to last-second 19-17 preseason win over Rams

headlines.description: — The Detroit Lions believe they have found the backup quarterback and depth receiver they were looking for this preseason.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions QB Kyle Allen, rookie WR Isaac TeSlaa solidify roster chances in 26-7 preseason loss to Texans

events.name: Denver Broncos at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — Saints coach Kellen Moore will have to decide soon whether rookie Tyler Shough or second-year pro Spencer Rattler should be New Orleans' starting quarterback in Week 1 of the regular season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints coach Kellen Moore says his QB decision will be 'challenging' after 28-19 loss to the Broncos

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — The Green Bay Packers gave Seattle Seahawks rookie Jalen Milroe some hard lessons about life in the NFL.
headlines.shortLinkText: Malik Willis has TD pass and Packers sack Jalen Milroe 5 times in 20-7 preseason win over Seahawks

headlines.description: — Tua Tagovailoa threw a 25-yard touchdown pass and was sacked twice in his only action of the preseason, and the Miami Dolphins beat the Jacksonville Jaguars 14-6 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tua Tagovailoa throws TD pass and is sacked twice as Dolphins beat Jaguars 14-6 to wrap preseason

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — Shane Buechele made the most of his first opportunity to play a full game in the NFL, showing 31 other teams what he can do.
headlines.shortLinkText: With Josh Allen sitting out, Shane Buechele leads Bills to a 23-19 preseason victory over the Bucs

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — Trey Lance's return to the Bay Area led to three straight punts for the Los Angeles Chargers, who went on to lose 30-23 Saturday night to the San Francisco 49ers in the final exhibition game for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: The 49ers spoil Trey Lance's return to the Bay Area with a 30-23 win over the Chargers

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: — It was another short night for Geno Smith, Maxx Crosby and the Las Vegas Raiders starters.
headlines.shortLinkText: Geno Smith throws TD pass in only drive for Raiders, who fall to Cardinals 20-10
